name: Vibe Voice
description: Local speech-to-text via the Vibe Voice process supervised by Vibe Terminal
author: Vibe Terminal

config_fields.label: Base URL
config_fields.description: URL of the local Vibe Voice. Mirrors the Local ASR Server bind/port setting.

config_fields.label: Access Token
config_fields.description: Bearer token for the ASR server. Leave empty if no token is configured. For the local supervised server this mirrors the Local ASR Server card; for remote servers, set the token they expect.

config_fields.label: Language
config_fields.description: Language hint sent to the ASR server on every transcription. Use 'auto' to let the server auto-detect, or a specific name (Chinese, English, Japanese, ...).
